Read only the metadata of an IVT file (no value decoding)

Source: R/read.R
ivt_metadata.Rd

Much faster than read_ivt() when you only need the codebook: table identity, dimension members, geographic identifiers (names + DGUIDs) and footnotes.

Usage

ivt_metadata(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .ivt file.

Value

A list of metadata (see read_ivt()).

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "98100044.ivt", package = "canivt")
meta <- ivt_metadata(path)
meta$dimensions
